scenario: Service declarations are part of a library's importable surface per LIMP.7.3 (cross-cite LADP). Pin: a library declares one dotted service; the rules-file imports its domain selectively; a `call <domain>.<method>` action resolves and compiles. Mirror coverage of LADP.8.1 from the LIMP-side angle.
rules_ds:
from ha import light

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    call light.turn_on entity_id: "x" cooldown: 30_s

libraries.ha:
service light.turn_on:
    kwarg entity_id: String literal required
    no response
